units.name: Department of Management and Marketing
units.evidence: Official current department houses formal Associate Lecturer of Logistics and Supply Chain Management; college independently lists substantive Supply Chain Management microcredential. Actual combined host preserved, no invented standalone logistics department.

decisions.reason: Current exact Management and Marketing department in College of Business Administration explicitly hosts Logistics and Supply Chain Management faculty role; subject is not separate department.

sources.note: Entire current official Graduate Degrees and Certificates page read through Chrome accessibility tree after navigation timeout. Explicit Accredited Master’s Degrees, full lists for Arts/Sciences, Business, Education/Human Development; master degrees, SSP School Psychology, certificates and microcredentials. No doctoral award listed. Engineering/IE doctorate not inferred from Texas A&M system name.

Entire College of Business Administration overview read. Three actual departments Accounting/Finance, Subhani Computer Information Systems, Management/Marketing. Full undergraduate and graduate provision; undergraduate Supply Chain Management microcredential explicitly not a degree. Graduate only Accounting MS, MBA, IS MS, Leadership MS.

Entire actual Department of Management and Marketing page read for unit scope. Explicit College of Business Administration parent, bachelor programmes and MBA/MS Leadership; faculty includes formal Associate Lecturer of Logistics and Supply Chain Management. No career histories collected. Combined current department houses subject; not a separate SCM department.

limitations: Supply Chain Management microcredential explicitly not an academic degree; not doctoral proof.
Current source-bounded graduate inventory only, not historical absence claim.
